SP Gray Commits to 1-Year Rockies Offer
The Colorado front office announced the signing of <Jon Gray:player#33575> today as the team's new starting pitcher. The 35-year-old came to terms with the <Rockies:team#9> and will be hauling in $4,880,000 a year over 1 year.

During his career, <Gray:player#33575> has recorded 80 wins and 82 losses with a 4.40 ERA and limited other teams to a .255 average.
